## Change

Describe the user action, the old and new behavior, and the affected entry points. For a refactor, identify the behavior that must survive.

## Verification

List the commands run and outcomes. Include bilingual and keyboard checks for UI changes, old-vault and concurrency cases for storage, and same-machine measurements for performance claims. Document any remaining manual checks.

## Distribution

For changes to packaging, persisted formats, public interfaces or demo assets, describe compatibility, rollback and the public files reviewed.
